# PureCanvas

> A local-first vector design app for the browser.

PureCanvas is a privacy-first, browser-based vector design tool. Everything is
stored locally in your browser — no account, no server, no uploads. Works fully offline.
PureCanvas is also open-source and designed to be user-friendly and agent-friendly.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.purecanvas.app/): The full vector design editor with an
  infinite dot-grid canvas, tools (Select, Text, Image, Line, Shape, Icon, Pen),
  layers, undo/redo, and export to SVG, PNG, WEBP, or direct clipboard copy.

## Source
- [GitHub](https://github.com/teccdev): Source code and development guide.
